limitations: Development verification only; official evaluation has not run.
The original waveform does not distinguish falling-edge q capture from a low-level latch driven by p. Falling-edge capture was selected.
Behavior under unknown clock or a after initialization is unspecified by the original waveform.

justified_RTL_TB_changes.initial_implementation: p is a high-level transparent latch; q captures p on falling clock edges. Neither output is initialized. The independent testbench uses literal expectations from the original table at the original timestamps.
